policy.name: Native Refine General Agent Loop - Interactive Candidates

selection.selection_rule: Exact user-endorsed asset, appearance, native retention, semantics, additions, display gates, structure, physics, recency; unknown is not passed.
selection.scope: Best available display evidence among saved candidates; not a guarantee of physical or perceptual optimality.

native_policy.reason: Preserve all native faces, UVs and PBR while allowing only small visible structural connections required for usable motion.

repairs.name: rear_stationary_connector
repairs.reason: The native side/rear views show a complete air gap between upper fascia and lower housing. Add only two small rear vertical support members bridging native z~0.08 to 0.19, at y~0.43 and x~+/-0.32, with cross section at most 0.035 by 0.035 native units. Owner housing; approximate hidden support, not recovered hardware.

repairs.name: cover_hinge_connector
repairs.reason: Add a short stationary rear hinge strip on housing and coaxial moving knuckle on cover only if native cover/fascia support is visibly disconnected at 0,45,90 degrees. Axis through native [0,0.470,0.270], parallel x. Each member belongs exclusively to its named owner; hinge length <=0.12 native units, radius <=0.018. Preserve all source geometry.

repairs.name: lower_root_connector
repairs.reason: If lower support root has a visible disconnect during its 90-degree fold, add only short coaxial root tabs at the stated pivot, housing-side tab owned by housing and moving tab owned by lower_support, each within 0.04 native units of the pivot edge and total width <=0.12. No broad tray reconstruction.

selection.reason: Visible seams, front projections and outlined control provide bounded semantic ownership; ordered subtraction gives exactly one owner per native face.

interactions.name: independent_motion_sequence
interactions.action: Use position commands with finite force limits: rest, each DOF independently to midpoint and endpoint then return; one brief combined pose only if cheap. q0=0 for every joint, cover/lower 0,pi/4,pi/2; slide 0,.0325,.065 m; control 0,.00075,.0015 m. The host alone runs the one bounded real mj_step attempt.
interactions.expected: Measure actual body transforms and visible surface displacement for all four targets, stable return and honest collision results. Compare visible ownership/support continuity at every finite midpoint and endpoint using actual parent hierarchy. Fix binding via supported offsets, never by removing the joint.

interactions.name: native_ownership_and_support
interactions.action: Partition source stable faces using the ordered geometric selections; inspect one colored ownership view. Preserve each native triangle and UV/PBR exactly once. Check attachment distance at 0,45,90 degrees for hinges and start/middle/end for slides. Use only bounded approved connection additions if needed and ledger their real areas. Treat source pose as q0, not a discovered joint axis.
interactions.expected: Output distinct render roots, complete native assignment and visible moving surfaces. Housing remains a fixed demo reference. Dedicated small collision proxies maintain supported contact scope; a broad collision or disconnected endpoint remains a reported failure, not full acceptance.

review_requirements: Check one colored ownership view and the stable-face ledger: every native face belongs exactly once to housing, cover, lower_support, central_support or control; no faces are removed or edited and native UV/PBR is preserved. The cover includes its thin rim, lower_support includes its moving side rims without stationary towers, and control follows the visible circular perimeter using outward fascia faces. At q=0 all render roots reconstruct the source under the declared scale/offset. Record any supported render-to-physics offset; do not delete functional joints to fix frame differences.

At cover_open and lower_fold values 0, pi/4 and pi/2, and central_retract values 0, 0.0325 and 0.065 m, inspect visible attachment continuity using transformed surfaces and record root/connection gaps in metres. Confirm front edges rise for both hinges, stationary fascia stays fixed, and the central member remains engaged with its opening during retraction. Inspect control_press at 0, 0.00075 and 0.0015 m for a bounded inward press in its housing. Use only the three approved connectors under their proper owners and area budgets. Report detached or broad-intersecting poses as failures; neither fine interiors nor an all-pose sweep is required.

Use only the one host mj_step attempt to record independent actuation and return for cover_open, lower_fold, central_retract and control_press. Compare actual joint positions with targets and actual visible surface transforms, including the fixed housing reference. All four selected visible regions must move with their physical bodies; press stroke must be measurably nonzero in its inward direction rather than passing solely because the generic global endpoint tolerance exceeds the 1.5 mm command. Record achieved press stroke and a close view of control/fascia relative displacement. Keep simulated success, failed motion and parameter-preview-only motion distinct.

Record neutral-pose and tested-pose contacts with simple proxies that cover the intended visible bodies while leaving front cavities available to the supports. Classify measured penetration with the frozen physics_tolerances helper, using its locality extension only with complete real locality evidence; broad/deep overlap remains failure. No additional full dynamics attempt or long collision sweep is required. Measure added connector areas against individual repair caps and total 0.035 native-area cap. Preserve generous initial hinge ranges unless optional limited-joint backoff has valid receipts and consistent updated artifacts.

Deliver complete native-preserving GLB, MJCF, action plan and manifest retaining all four declared nonfixed joints even if the host physics attempt fails. Label actual achieved motion and failed tests separately from parameter preview. Explicitly retain missing sheet transport, other button/electrical behavior, hidden interiors and estimated mechanism limitations; do not claim full functional coverage, full material acceptance or strict collision-free motion.

interaction_coverage.label: Lift and close the broad top cover
interaction_coverage.reason: Closed thin panel and rear edge support a rear hinge prior; keep upper dark control fascia stationary and attempt 90 degrees.

interaction_coverage.label: Fold and deploy the lower attached support
interaction_coverage.reason: Forward lower plate and root/side guides support a front-root fold; q=0 is native deployed state and positive q lifts its front edge through 90 degrees.

interaction_coverage.label: Press the visible circular directional control
interaction_coverage.reason: Outlined circular control supports a 1.5 mm downward short-travel press with return; electrical function and every individual control are outside this mechanical demonstration.

interaction_coverage.label: Retract and extend the narrow central support
interaction_coverage.reason: Thin horizontal projecting member meets the front opening without an observed knuckle; choose a 65 mm guided slide as editable approximate prior over an equally possible fold.

approximation_gaps.reason: Native air gap, incomplete concealed scan surface and internal sheet path remain approximate. Only reviewed small connectors may be added; preserve all source faces and native PBR.

Use conservative simple boxes for stationary shell walls and upper platform, thin slabs for supports and a small control proxy. Do not use one solid housing box that fills the front tray openings. Detailed grooves, internal guides and neural seams are omitted; tolerate only policy-compliant measured contacts.
